name: io.github.provared/mcp-executor
title: Provared MCP executor
description: Checks each tool call against a passkey-signed permission, then writes a countersigned receipt.

packageArguments.description: Run as the tool server that the agent's MCP client starts.
The next argument names the executor's settings file.

Path of the executor's settings file (executor.json): the real tool server to start and its credentials, the agent's keys, permission and book, the executor's keys and copy, and the rule for each tool. See the README.
